title: FreeCAD CLI compatibility test aligned with strict proxy-cache refusal
scope: Diagnose the existing fast FreeCAD CLI CTest failure on tracked special DWG samples
Preserve the ordinary successful FreeCAD argv control
Require explicit atomic refusal when typed proxy-graphics caches cannot be replayed

method.initialObservedFailure: The pre-correction compatibility test expected RTEXT/ARCALIGNEDTEXT and MPOLYGON conversions to succeed; the installed local converter returned nonzero with typed-proxy-graphics-not-preserved, correctly withholding DXF publication.
method.limitations: Tracked fixture refusal is a local policy/behavior check, not successful conversion support for proxy caches, native FreeCAD runtime evidence, or semantic geometry evidence.

assessment.nextOwner: Any expansion of DXF proxy-graphics replay must remain a per-type/subclass-scope capability with exact raw bytes, version/count-code provenance, and parser/writer round-trip evidence. Do not weaken the current fail-closed gate to satisfy an entity-count assertion.
